text: Billing v2 cutover plan (PayStream): 1) Oct 20 shadow-invoice all customers in PayStream and diff against legacy, 2) Oct 27 freeze legacy price changes, 3) Nov 1 PayStream becomes system of record for November invoices. Rollback = flip `billing.provider` back to legacy. Details in ADR-007.
